name: Release v0.66.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Update ROADMAP.md to no longer reference outdated 2025 roadmap by @DavidAPierce in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29723
* Changelog for v0.65.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29739
* chore(release): bump version to 0.66.0-nightly.20261013.g204db94ae by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29740
* Changelog for v0.64.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29741
* fix(ui): implement synchronized output and isolate spinner rendering by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29725
* fix(ui): fix debug console height calculation and terminalBuffer flickering by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29695
* fix(cli): prevent right-hand border bleed in scrollable tool containers by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29742
* refactor(core,cli): emit tool call groups from the scheduler and drop the UI lookahead by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29736
* fix(core): format and quote Windows diff command arguments in openDiff by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29753
* fix(cli): round before selecting units in formatDuration by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29766
* fix(core): disable interactive credential and SSH prompts in getSafeGitEnv by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29760
* fix(cli): resolve settings placeholders after loading .env files by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29750
* fix(core): harden SKILL.md frontmatter parsing for single-line descriptions by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29769
* Add Banner about Gemini CLI not being optimized for Gemini 4 by @srithreepo in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29774
* Update README to remove obsolete content by @srithreepo in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29775
* fix(ci): remove unsupported members permission in unassign-inactive-assignees workflow by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29770
* fix(cli): reset slash-command conflict dedupe when conflicts reappear by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29768
* fix(cli): verify active binary update to prevent PATH shadowing false success by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29757
* fix(cli): support 'keys' array in keybindings.json by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29773
* fix(cli): forward termination signals from bootstrap parent to child process by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29790
* fix(ui): preserve terminal scrollback during viewport refreshes by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29792
* fix(cli): decode streamed Node HTTP activity chunks with StringDecoder by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29827
* chore: migrate gsutil usage to gcloud storage by @gurusai-voleti in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29839
* fix(core): preserve user-level ~/.gitconfig in shell and git environments by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29832
* fix(core): prevent false positive matches in isAuthenticationError by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29835
* fix(core): support opt-in private network endpoints for MCP OAuth flows by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29844

## New Contributors
* @gurusai-voleti made their first contribution in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29839

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/compare/v0.65.0...v0.66.0
